notes.title: The Autumn sale is here with the release of 1.0!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197592/5b8b43ead79157aba19cfb4302582f223e9ed8ac.png[/img]

Hello, everyone,
6 Keys: The Gym is finally done with early access on the 25th today and the official version is coming out!

With the release of the full version of 6 Keys: The Gym, there's a 33% discount on the Autumn sale, so don't miss this opportunity!

Key changes to the official version
Add a new chapter
- 5 gimics, 3 boogymics -> 20 gimics

Thank you so much to gamers around the world for playing 6 Keys: The Gym and giving me interest and feedback.
I hope you enjoy playing and I will be able to inform you about your plans after the official release in the near future.
Thank you.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1 | patch notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197592/443aef47ed325c613997020410fb32cecbea3990.png[/img]

We have a new announcement for students.
After collecting opinions from students in the suggestion box, we decided to proceed with improvements to the gymnasium.

[b]Improvements in this update include:[/b]

[h3][b]Add anomaly[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Add storage door ghost
[*] Add basketball cart ghost 
[*] Ghosts added to evacuation route
[*] Add corner anomaly
[/list]

[h3][b]Modify probability of ghost appearance[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] 50% -> 100%
[/list]

[h3][b]Add result window[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The ending shows how many ghosts you saw out of the total number of ghosts.
[/list]

[h3][b]Tutorial supplement[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added blackboard, modified key collection box size
[/list]

The opinions you provide in the suggestion box really help us in our direction and development.
thank you!
